entities.summary: Grigory Danilovich Yastrebenetsky was a Russian sculptor. He served on the Eastern Front in World War II. Yastrebenetsky was honoured with the People's Artist of the RSFSR (1984). He was also a member of the Russian Academy of Arts.

entities.summary: Grigory Danilovich Yastrebenetsky was a Russian sculptor. He served on the Eastern Front in World War II. Yastrebenetsky was honoured with the People's Artist of the RSFSR (1984). He was also a member of the Russian Academy of Arts.
